title: Bound on the total size of a circuit list
statement: Let $m$ be a natural number and let $cs$ be a finite list of Boolean circuits on $n$ variables. If each circuit $c$ in $cs$ satisfies $\mathrm{size}(c)+1\le m$, then the sum of their sizes plus the length of the list is at most the length of the list multiplied by $m$.
hypotheses_covered: $cs$ is a finite list of Boolean circuits on $n$ variables
